proposals.before: In year 2, the empress dowager established her brother's son Marquis Lü Tai of Lü as King of Lü, carving out Jinan commandery from Qi as the King of Lü's fief.
proposals.after: In year 2, the empress dowager established her brother's son Lü Tai, the Marquis of Li, as King of Lü, carving out Jinan commandery from Qi as the King of Lü's fief.
proposals.reason: Chinese 酈侯呂臺 is Lü Tai, Marquis of Li (酈), not 'Marquis Lü Tai of Lü'; the literal fuses the marquisate with the surname.

proposals.before: In King Ai's third year, his younger brother Zhang entered Han's palace guard service. Empress Lü enfeoffed him as Marquis of Zhuxu and married him to Lü Lü's daughter.
proposals.after: In King Ai's third year, his younger brother Zhang entered Han's palace guard service. Empress Lü enfeoffed him as Marquis of Zhuxu and married him to Lü Lu's daughter.
proposals.reason: Chinese 呂祿 is Lü Lu; literal erroneously doubles the surname as 'Lü Lü'.

proposals.before: King Lü Lü of Zhao served as supreme general, King Lü Chan of Lü served as chancellor. Both resided in Chang'an, gathered troops to intimidate the ministers, and wished to rebel.
proposals.after: King Lü Lu of Zhao served as supreme general; King Lü Chan of Lü served as chancellor. Both resided in Chang'an, gathered troops to intimidate the ministers, and wished to rebel.
proposals.reason: Chinese 呂祿 is Lü Lu; literal writes 'Lü Lü'.

proposals.before: Lü Lü and Lü Chan wished to rebel in Guanzhong. Marquis Zhuxu together with Grand Marshal Bo and Chancellor Chen and others executed them.
proposals.after: Lü Lu and Lü Chan wished to rebel in Guanzhong. Marquis Zhuxu together with Grand Commandant Bo and Chancellor Ping and others executed them.
proposals.reason: Chinese 呂祿 is Lü Lu (not Lü Lü); 太尉勃 is Grand Commandant Bo; 丞相平 is Chancellor Ping, not Chen.

proposals.before: The Daoist proverb says, "When you should act decisively but hesitate, you bring chaos upon yourself." How true that is!'
proposals.after: The Daoist saying goes, 'When one ought to decide and does not, one instead suffers the ensuing disorder.' This is exactly the case!'
proposals.reason: Closing quotation and proverb rendering can track 當斷不斷，反受其亂 more closely; minor polish.

proposals.before: That same year, King Ai of Qi died, and his heir, Ze, ascended the throne, becoming known as King Wen.
proposals.after: That same year, King Ai of Qi died, and his heir, Ze (則), ascended the throne, becoming known as King Wen.
proposals.reason: Chinese heir name is 則 (Ze); idiomatic already has Ze—confirm spelling consistency with 側 variant noted in source apparatus.

proposals.before: The generals of the three kingdoms seized the Chamberlain and forced him to swear an oath, saying, "If you falsely report that Han has been defeated and urge Qi to surrender to us at once, Qi will soon be slaughtered."
proposals.after: The generals of the three kingdoms seized the Chamberlain and forced him to swear an oath, saying, "If you do not falsely report that Han has already been defeated and urge Qi to surrender quickly to the three kingdoms, you will be slaughtered."
proposals.reason: Chinese 不且見屠 threatens the envoy (or Qi) if he refuses the false report; idiomatic inverts the conditional.

proposals.before: He reigned for a total of thirty-three years and died. His son Yan succeeded him and became King Qing.
proposals.after: He reigned for a total of thirty-three years and died. His son Yan (延) succeeded him and became King Qing.
proposals.reason: Chinese apparatus notes ［建］延; personal name is 延 (Yan).

proposals.before: He sent Marquis Jipu Chai as general to attack and defeat, capturing the King of Jibei. The king committed suicide, and the territory reverted to Han, becoming a commandery.
proposals.after: He sent General Chai, the Marquis of Jipu, who defeated and captured the King of Jibei. The king committed suicide, and the territory reverted to Han as a commandery.
proposals.reason: Chinese 棘蒲侯柴將軍 is Marquis of Jipu, General Chai; literal word order is awkward.

proposals.before: The King of Qi dispatched the Chamberlain for the Capital to carry word to the Son of Heaven.
proposals.after: The King of Qi sent Palace Grandee Lu to carry word to the Son of Heaven.
proposals.reason: 路 is the envoy's surname and 中大夫 his office; the old translation misread the whole expression as an office title.

proposals.before: The Son of Heaven instructed the Chamberlain to return to Qi with this message: 'Hold fast in your defense. My armies have now defeated Wu and Chu.'
proposals.after: The Son of Heaven instructed Palace Grandee Lu to return to Qi with this message: 'Hold fast in your defense. My armies have now defeated Wu and Chu.'
proposals.reason: 路中大夫 is Palace Grandee Lu, the same named envoy as in the surrounding sentences.

decisions.reason: 酈侯 is Lü Tai's marquisate, the Marquis of Li; it is not part of his personal name.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 二年，高后立其兄子酈侯呂臺為呂王，割齊之濟南郡為呂王奉邑。

decisions.reason: 呂祿 is Lü Lu; the first Lü is the surname and 祿 is Lu.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 哀王三年，其弟章入宿衛於漢，呂太后封為朱虛侯，以呂祿女妻之。

decisions.reason: 呂祿 is Lü Lu, not Lü Lü.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 趙王呂祿為上將軍，呂王產為相國，皆居長安中，聚兵以威大臣，欲為亂。

decisions.after: Lü Lu and Lü Chan plotted rebellion within the passes, but the Marquis of Zhuxu, Grand Commandant Zhou Bo, Chancellor Chen Ping, and their allies put them to death.
decisions.reason: 太尉勃 and 丞相平 are Grand Commandant Zhou Bo and Chancellor Chen Ping; the old literal text misnames both men.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 呂祿、呂產欲作亂關中，朱虛侯與太尉勃、丞相平等誅之。

decisions.reason: The current idiomatic proverb is fluent and faithfully conveys 當斷不斷，反受其亂; the proposed rewrite is unnecessary.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 道家之言『當斷不斷，反受其亂』，乃是也。」

decisions.reason: The current English already gives the corrected name Ze; source-apparatus graphs should not be inserted into the reader-facing translation.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 是歲，齊哀王卒，太子（側）［則］立，是為文王。

decisions.after: The generals of the three kingdoms seized Palace Grandee Lu and forced him to swear an oath, saying, "When you return, say that Han has already been defeated and that Qi should quickly surrender to the three kingdoms. If you do not, you will be killed."
decisions.reason: 若反言 means 'when you return, say,' and 不且見屠 supplies the threatened consequence if Palace Grandee Lu refuses.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 三國將劫與路中大夫盟，曰：「若反言漢已破矣，齊趣下三國，不且見屠。」

decisions.after: After a total reign of thirty-three years, he died. His son Yan succeeded him as King Qing.
decisions.reason: The successor is Liu Yan; 建 is source apparatus, not an additional part of his personal name.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 凡三十三年卒，子［建］延立，是為頃王。

decisions.reason: 棘蒲侯柴將軍 identifies General Chai as the Marquis of Jipu; the revised word order is clear and grammatical.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 使棘蒲侯柴將軍擊破虜濟北王，王自殺，地入于漢，為郡。

decisions.reason: 路 is the envoy's surname and 中大夫 his office; the old translation treated the whole expression as an office title.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 齊王使路中大夫告於天子。

decisions.reason: 路中大夫 again names Palace Grandee Lu, the envoy returning from the Han court.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 天子復令路中大夫還告齊王：「善堅守，吾兵今破吳楚矣。」

claimRevisions.reason: 路 is the envoy's surname and 中大夫 his office; the full title-reference should remain linkable.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 齊王使路中大夫告於天子。

claimRevisions.reason: The former Chamberlain alias was a mistranslation of the surname-plus-office expression 路中大夫.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 天子復令路中大夫還告齊王：「善堅守，吾兵今破吳楚矣。」

claimAdditions.reason: The title 太尉 and given name 勃 in this event identify Grand Commandant Zhou Bo.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 呂祿、呂產欲作亂關中，朱虛侯與太尉勃、丞相平等誅之。

claimAdditions.reason: The title 丞相 and given name 平 in this event identify Chancellor Chen Ping.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 呂祿、呂產欲作亂關中，朱虛侯與太尉勃、丞相平等誅之。

claimAdditions.reason: 中大夫 is Palace Grandee, while 路 is the officeholder's surname.
